rows.text: You swallow beautiful old memories. They have a spongy texture. The owner of the restaurant slaps the air with their fins. The final course is served to your table.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Among the seasoning of the small roasted fire serpent, unending layers of mountain ranges shield the soft and chewy texture beneath the crisp-fried surface like a protective screen. You want to refuse yet embrace it anyway. You transform into a breeze and drift across a cooling battlefield until you float among a sea of clouds.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: After many years, the once-young man has become a famous Cloud Knight Lieutenant. Having stolen a moment of leisure, you down half a bowl of tea in the Exalting Sanctum. But the road ahead is long, and you still have unspent energy you yearn to put to use. You want to become a well-known hero on the Xianzhou!
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: I will stand upon the Wardance's arena
You continue to surmount all obstacles in your way. As you look upon your opponents' swords, you know that this is also another life worth sampling.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: I will rout the abominations of the Plague Author
You hoist your luggage onto your shoulder and walk into the port of the Xianzhou Yaoqing, where a new life for sampling awaits.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
